premises: Most type-A HEA superconductors are Nb–Ta-rich with Ti < 20 at.%
Binary Nb–Ti alloys have better superconducting properties than Nb–Ta
In ternary/quaternary Nb–Ti–X alloys, Ti-rich compositions show the highest upper critical fields
Tc in related HEA systems evolves mainly as a function of valence electron count
Local lattice distortion from atomic size mismatch modifies the phonon spectrum and electron–phonon coupling
